sara: Heads-up — seeing abrupt generation flips when serving Gemma weights mapped to Qwen tokenspace on long-context runs. Suspect a rotary angle wrap at a token-id boundary, noisy in fp16/quantized runs.

vik: Can you paste the smallest repro or a log snippet?

sara: Repro (short):
```
# quick mapping we used to convert Gemma->Qwen rotary positions
def convert_pos(pos, vocab_offset):
    # naive map, was used in onboarding script
    return pos + vocab_offset

# observed: when pos % 512 == 0 we see phase flip in attn scores
```

mike: That looks like an angle wrap. If pos*inv_freq crosses +/-pi because of an off-by-one in token ids you'll get a sign flip in sin/cos. Could also be headwise scaling + fp16 rounding nudging the boundary.

sara: Minimal log: "attn_head_3: cos_old=0.9998, cos_new=-0.9997 at token 1024" — happens reproducibly on a handful of tokens across prompts.

vik: Try shifting positions by -1 for a smoke test (i.e., convert_pos(pos, vocab_offset-1)). If ppl improves it's likely tokenmap off-by-one.

mike: Ran a quick A/B on eval-1000: baseline ppl=19.8, pos_shift=-1 ppl=19.1, pos_shift=+1 ppl=30.2 (clearly bad). Diff skewed to long-context QA items.

sara: Interesting — quantized fp16 build shows larger jumps. Non-quant baseline less dramatic but still present. So rounding pushes some angles across the discontinuity.

vik: Action: add a conversion shim in onboarding that normalizes the rotary phase mapping and a unit test asserting continuity across the token id boundary. Also log any tokenids that map exactly to the discontinuity.

sara: Adding a small conversion + config so teams can try offset -1 until tokenizer fix lands. Draft config: 
```
onboard:
  rotary_offset: -1
  test_repro: tests/rotary/angle_wrap.py::repro_longctx
```

mike: I'll wire that into the eval harness and run overnight full-suite. Also add a quick numerical check: ensure max(|sin(a)-sin(b)|) < 1e-3 across the mapping window.

sara: Opening PR now (small script + tests). tagging @mike for the eval job.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to prod-dedicated-3 with tag rotary-fix-canary :rocket:

ci-bot: CI summary for PR #4321: 12/14 unit tests passed, 2 flaky unrelated. Eval quick-run: delta ppl -0.7 on abstractive summarization benchmark, long-context F1 +3.2. Full nightly queued.

vik: If nightly confirms, we'll roll to dedicated canaries and add a console metric for "rotary_discontinuity_hits" so SRE can watch.

sara: On it — will also add an onboarding checklist entry: "verify rotary continuity for model->tokenmap conversions". Thanks team :tada:
